PartnerStackAPIKeys.x-credential-instructions: In your vendor dashboard, open Settings → Integrations → PartnerStack API Keys. Paste the public and secret keys from the same test or production pair. Test keys work with test partners and customers; production keys perform live actions. NoClick sends these keys over HTTPS using Basic authentication.
